about_the_game:
Game Description:

In the game, the player will play the role of a person bound by the sword, the sword absorbs essence and blood for a living, nourishes his body with flesh and blood, in order to survive, you will be in this virtual world non-stop killing,

Find more essence blood for the sword, and in return, you will gain great power, and if one day you can no longer provide for the sword, the next provider of essence blood may be you!

Game Features:

Players will experience the thrill of battle in the fantasy world, and the unique talent system allows you to have more choices for attribute allocation, and the reasonable allocation of these attribute points will bring you a different combat experience

With a unique top-down action design gameplay, you can defeat powerful monsters through combat skills such as rolling and charged attacks, or you can remotely pull away to consume opponents, with a variety of battle strategy options
